# Folder mode tests compare ordered URIs after row expansion

checkModeListItems first yields to an idle callback, expands each row and waits a frame per expansion, then deep-compares the displayed row URIs with the expected folder URIs. The idle callback gives listeners time but does not observe their completion by itself. This is the fixed test oracle; the assigned third attempt and historical local verify report do not prove an intermittent cure. Bug 1848132 comment 8 is unavailable. No test ran.

Scope: fixed-mode-list-assertions.
